units.rawText: When I first heard the legend of Yu Boya and Zhong Ziqi, I found it quite touching, but I didn't understand why Yu was so adamant.

units.rawText: But I think I get it now... If one day, we were to part forever, I'm afraid I'll never want to play music ever again.

units.rawText: That's right. You're the only one who understands my music and feelings. If you weren't here to listen to it, what would be the point in playing?
